name: Twist the Knife (Combat) (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
You know where to strike an enemy to inflict the most pain possible.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack +2d6, Weapon Focus with a melee weapon.

Benefit: Whenever you confirm a critical hit while wielding a melee weapon for which you have the Weapon Focus feat, instead of multiplying the base damage of the weapon, you instead deal additional damage as though you made a successful sneak attack. If the attack was already a sneak attack, roll d8s instead of d6s for your damage. In addition, for a number of rounds equal to the number of sneak attack dice you possess, the target takes a –2 penalty on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks as they are wracked with pain. This is a pain effect.
